bullets.title: NVDA: MediaTek $3.5B convertible + NVLink Fusion partnership; strategic equity portfolio at $99B
bullets.body: UBS highlights NVDA's ~$3.5B convertible bond investment in MediaTek with a strategic partnership spanning AI infrastructure, PCs, edge AI, and automotive—MediaTek's NVLink Fusion adoption challenges AVGO and seeds NVDA's scale-up architecture across custom ASICs. Separately, NVDA's strategic equity portfolio has grown to $99B (from $7B a year prior) with $40B+ in 2026 AI-company commitments to secure manufacturing access. Jensen Huang declared 'AGI has arrived' on OpenAI Astra, reinforcing AI infrastructure narrative.

bullets.title: Semis upcycle: DRAM +259% YoY ASP, industry heading to $1.73T in 2026; JPM/UBS both bullish
bullets.body: JPM raises 2026 semiconductor industry outlook to $1.73T (+118% YoY) with >$2T in 2027; DRAM ASPs +259% YoY and NAND +344% YoY even after deceleration. UBS models DRAM contract prices rising 22% Q/Q in 3Q26 and 9% in 4Q26; Samsung and SK Hynix inventories below 10 days of supply. Token consumption up 10x YTD driving agentic AI workloads that are fundamentally memory-bound—HBM/DRAM bottleneck seen persisting to 2030.

bullets.title: INTC +4.5% pre-market: Northland upgrades to Outperform ($120 PT); CPU prices set to rise 10%
bullets.body: Northland Capital Markets upgrades INTC to Outperform from Market Perform with a $120 PT (25% upside from $95.80). Digitimes reports Intel PC CPU prices set to rise another 10% on supply chain constraints. JPM keeps INTC Underweight; Citi rates INTC Buy at TMT Conference.

bullets.title: ORCL +5% pre-market; Thursday earnings catalyst with OCI upside seen but CDS near record highs
bullets.body: ORCL rallying 5% on OpenAI Astra follow-through; OPCO regression analysis signals upside to OCI growth and RPO conversions, and additional GW capacity could support higher FY27 guidance. Financing risk persists—CDS near record highs as investors question datacenter capex scale. Earnings Thursday with consensus EPS $1.73 on $19.13B revenue.

bullets.title: ADBE: Multiple PT raises ahead of Thursday earnings; growth stuck in high-single digits
bullets.body: Mizuho raises ADBE PT to $260 from $245 (Neutral); Piper and OPCO also constructive. Web traffic accelerating 23% YoY, unique visitors +29% YoY, enterprise checks solid—guidance seen as beatable. Bear case: organic ARR growth anchored in high-single digits, AI-first ARR only ~2% of $26B total ARR, and monetization friction in prosumer/SMB segments (>65% of ARR). Consensus EPS $6.08 on $6.69B revenue Thursday.

bullets.title: SHOP: Piper raises PT to $180 (OW) on 32% 2027E rev growth vs Street +26%
bullets.body: Piper raises SHOP price target to $180 from $172, reiterating Overweight, modeling 2027E revenue of $19.5B (up from $19.2B) and FCF of $4.2B (up from $3.9B). Key drivers: monetization of existing merchant base and FCF margin expansion of ~170bps annually 2026E–2029E vs Street ~98bps. Stock down ~2% pre-market, consistent with broader software weakness.

bullets.title: HOOD: Morgan Stanley upgrades to OW ($150 PT); Goldman raises to $142 on Rothera scaling
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley upgrades Robinhood to Overweight, raising PT to $150 from $124, citing improving monetization across 13 business lines and digital asset convergence with 28M+ customers and $355B platform assets. Goldman separately raises HOOD PT to $142 from $124 (Buy), modeling Rothera prediction markets exchange at $307M revenue in 2027 (~5% of total). Robinhood Chain hit record $3.75M fees on Sept 1; DEX volume $1.6B, DeFi deposits $750M.

bullets.title: META: JPM sees unrecognized AI winner at 18x 2027E EPS; Muse Spark at 47% OpenCode share
bullets.body: JPM calls META the most undervalued AI winner—trading at 18x 2027E EPS despite being a cutting-edge LLM lab. Muse Spark 1.3 gaining 47% market share in OpenCode coding agent ecosystem; Muse agent consumer/business launch expected at Meta Connect Sept 23; Watermelon model (next major) expected late Sept/Oct. ChatGPT ads hit $1B annualized run rate, validating the ad-AI monetization thesis broadly.

bullets.title: APP: Sentiment at 2-year lows despite >50% rev growth, 79% EBIT margins, ROIC >100%
bullets.body: APP Max platform reaches ~1.4B daily users across 140K+ apps with exceptional unit economics (EBIT margins >79%, profit margins ~65%, ROIC >100%), yet stock has compressed sharply on modest revenue miss, decelerating Q3 guidance, and lower margin guidance. Bulls argue recent weakness is buying opportunity; bears flag competition from GOOGL and META as existential threat to proprietary data advantage. Q3 guide of +7-8% Q/Q expected strong; Q4 guide is the critical read.

bullets.title: PLTR + NBIS: Partnership announced for sovereign AI infrastructure
bullets.body: Palantir names Nebius as preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner; Nebius compute and inference endpoints will be integrated into Palantir's enterprise perimeter. Companies will accelerate compute capacity deployment via modular data-center deployments at existing power sites. Morgan Stanley hosted a webcast on AI Sovereignty as a growing investment theme driven by government AI capex and tech fragmentation.

bullets.title: RBLX: 'Steal an Egg' drives peak CCUs to 25.7M (+16% W/W); JPM Neutral at $40 PT
bullets.body: JPM's weekly RBLX tracker shows peak platform CCUs surged to 25.7M Saturday, up 3.5M W/W (+16%), driven by the viral 'Steal an Egg' mini-game which hit 9.9M peak CCUs vs 6.3M prior week. RFY algorithm updates credited as the primary driver of viral inflection. JPM maintains Neutral/$40 PT but notes 18+ users monetize 50% higher than U18—key O18 initiative updates expected at RDC this week.

bullets.title: RDDT: Bears winning—US DAUs declined, Reddit citations dropping in ChatGPT, AI deal expectations reset
bullets.body: JPM notes RDDT bears winning as US DAUs declined last quarter and stock is down 25% from July high. Reddit citations dropping in ChatGPT per PromptWatch, reducing logged-out DAUs and weakening leverage on AI licensing deals. Investor expectations for 3x upside from AI partnerships have been ratcheted significantly lower.

bullets.title: TSLA: Hedgeye flips to Bearish trend; China domestic retail -12% YoY in August
bullets.body: Hedgeye's Risk Range signals flip TSLA from Bullish to Bearish trend. China data shows Tesla domestic retail (ex-export) ~50K units in August, -12% YoY, though exports were +39% YoY to 36K units. BYD continues to dominate with 234K units and market share ramping from 25% to 42% in recent weeks.

bullets.title: VST/CEG: Power names with insider support; two-month implied vol near YTD lows on AI power theme
bullets.body: OPCO notes VST and CEG offer cleaner risk-reward vs crowded AI infrastructure trades, with insider and institutional support and 2-month implied vol near YTD lows despite the secular AI power consumption story remaining intact. DOE closed a $1.9B loan for NextEra's Duane Arnold nuclear restart with Google signing a 25-year PPA for the 615MW Iowa facility to power AI/cloud infrastructure.

bullets.title: BE: S&P 500 inclusion (effective Sept 21) triggers ~$11B index inflows; Morgan Stanley constructive
bullets.body: Bloom Energy added to the S&P 500 effective September 21, representing approximately $11B in index-driven inflows, with the stock up ~5.7% pre-market. Morgan Stanley maintains a constructive stance on onsite generation names (BE) and powered shell plays (WULF, HUT) to address AI power bottlenecks at data centers.

bullets.title: CVNA: JPM sees CVNA as clearest beneficiary of off-lease vehicle supply inflection (+26% YoY in 2026)
bullets.body: JPM models off-lease used vehicle supply expanding +26%/+20%/+1% YoY in 2026/2027/2028 from 2023-24 lease cohort maturation. B2B automotive marketplaces and independent dealers (CVNA) are the clearest beneficiaries; rental operators (CAR, HTZ) face the most risk with ~10:1 leverage to used vehicle pricing. BEV mix of off-lease supply rising from 12% (2025) to 30% (2027-28).

bullets.title: SNPS: Morgan Stanley upgrades to Overweight, $500 PT (+27% upside)
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley upgrades Synopsys to Overweight from Equal-Weight with a $500 price target implying 27% upside from $393.84. Separately, Mizuho notes the EDA sell-off in CDNS and SNPS following OpenAI Astra PCB demo appears sentiment-driven and unwarranted, as Astra used free open-source KiCad rather than replacing commercial EDA engines.

bullets.title: GLW: China Renaissance initiates Buy at $238 PT (+54% upside)
bullets.body: China Renaissance Securities initiates Corning with a Buy rating and $238 price target, representing 54% upside from the current $154.30. The FactSet consensus target is $195.87, making this initiation well above the street average.

bullets.title: PANW: Downgraded to Neutral at Phillip Capital; PT raised to $346 but implies only 4% upside
bullets.body: Palo Alto Networks downgraded to Neutral from Accumulate at Phillip Capital with PT raised to $346 from $320, implying just 4% upside from $333.26. FactSet consensus PT is $397.79, suggesting the downgrade reflects valuation concerns at current levels rather than a fundamental deterioration view.

bullets.title: RH: Earnings Thursday (consensus EPS $0.38, rev $915M); Citi Neutral, productivity lagging peers
bullets.body: RH reports Thursday after close with Citi modeling Q2 sales above Street but below for 2H26 and FY26. Story remains idiosyncratic—success hinges on RH Estates expansion and international ramp. Citi labor productivity analysis highlights RH as one of only two companies with revenue/employee below 2019 levels, while WSM grew revenue/employee 81% cutting headcount 11%.
